body:
# Esotericism Tinker

## Overview

**Esotericism Tinker** is an add-on mod for **Tinkers' Construct 3**.

At its current stage, it functions partly like a library-style expansion, adding new recipe types, extensible systems, and ritual-based content for Tinkers' Construct and related mods.

## Added Content

This mod provides an in-game manual: **Hypnagogic Transmute**.
The book introduces the main direction of the mod and gives additional information for its add-on systems.

The first major system is **Transmute**, a switchable smelting structure themed around alchemy.

The second major system is the **Selenic Astrolabe**, a lunar structure themed around astrology. It can naturally generate at high elevations in the Overworld.

The Selenic Astrolabe supports **8 + 1 item inputs** and **1 fluid input**, and can output **1 item** and **1 fluid**.

It also supports generating Tinkers' Construct parts based on material ID, part category, or part type, such as tool heads.

The mod also adds a ritual dagger. By right-clicking with it, the player harms themselves to gain effects such as Resistance, Haste, and Strength.

## Compact

### Ars Nouveau

Esotericism Tinker adds Ars Nouveau integration through the Enchanting Apparatus.

These recipes allow players to apply modifiers to Tinkers' Construct tools through Ars Nouveau-style crafting.

The consumed modifier slots and Source cost can be customized by recipe.
